children: Former US Energy Secretary Ernest Moniz said the loss of International Atomic Energy Agency access to Iran has created a serious monitoring gap, making it harder to determine the status of the country's nuclear program, according to Bloomberg.
Moniz also said tight global supplies of diesel and other refined fuels could face added pressure as US refineries, already running near capacity, head into their fall maintenance season.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Moniz Warns IAEA Access Loss Leaves Iran Nuclear Monitoring Gap
